import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped and formatted HTML string ready for inclusion in a page. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("headline and content must be strings") # Escape all user supplied data to prevent injection attacks. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # Preserve newlines in the content by converting them to
tags. safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace('\n', '
\n') # Populate the template with sanitized data. rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered
